messages:
Sara (CS): Quick check — NovaCom reserved pool is scheduled for warmup tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need final gating on quota thresholds + autoscale policy. Are we green on the runbook?
Omar (SRE): I pulled the capacity metrics; current post-priming util estimated ~75% at baseline. I'll run a TTL smoke tonight. Can we keep burst headroom at 20%?
Ben (Platform): Confirmed model variant pinned to rdx-2.1-q8. Autoscaler policy staged: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=12, target_util=0.65. Snippet: `autoscaler: {min:2,max:12,target_cpu:65}`
Anjali (Eng): Watch KV cache priming — last time cold-starts spiked p99. Recommend warm-prefix cache job to hit top 50 prompts ahead of traffic.
Jin (NovaCom): thanks — we'll hold off heavy traffic until you say go. FYI our traffic shape ramps at 09:30 for ~20m then steadies.
deploy-bot: reserved-pool-priming job succeeded (3/3 shards). logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/priming/novacom/1788
Sara (CS): OK action items: 1) Ben push autoscaler policy to prod canary, 2) Anjali run cache primer, 3) Omar validate p99 < 250ms under 60% sustained load. Jin will provide precise ramp plan. ETA 30m for next checkpoint. :thumbsup:
Ben (Platform): pushing policy now to staging; will promote after smoke. command: `rctl apply --policy autoscaler-novacom.json`
Anjali (Eng): started primer job: `python tools/primer.py --top-k 50 --pool reserved-nova` — estimated run ~12m
Omar (SRE): Running loadtest: `loadtest --users 200 --rps 500 --profile nova-ramp.json` — preliminary p95 ~180ms, p99 ~420ms (cache cold)
Sara (CS): p99 420ms is above their VIP SLA. Can we mitigate before the big ramp?
Anjali (Eng): re-run after primer finishes; also enabling KV sticky routing for VIP routes should cut p99 by ~150ms in prior runs.
Ben (Platform): I can enable sticky routing via flag: `routing.v2.sticky=true` — prefer to canary at 10% first.
Jin (NovaCom): Please canary it. We'll hold ramp until p99 < 300ms.
Omar (SRE): Canaried sticky routing to 10% — p99 dropped to 210ms. Scaling canary to 30% now and keeping a tight monitor.
Sara (CS): Looks promising. I'll update NovaCom: ETA 30m for final go/no-go. Followups assigned: @Ben push canary -> prod if stable, @Anjali confirm primer complete, @Omar validate sustained p99 under 60% for 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
